summary: Resumed reviewer restored exact proposal, functionality, owned canonical/rendered C and both contextual caller reads. Independently confirmed both purpose changes and reconciled all 14 non-retain facts and two links; accepted existing compiled-layout, accessor/capture attribution and owner-lifetime deferrals. No overrides required.

proposed_facts.reason: Both dispatch entries select this physics callback. The nonzero x34 branch reverses facing, invokes direction-related setup, reloads x36 to 60, clears x34 and requests state 1 with ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE. Reflection produces the flag and animation consumes the countdown. The correction agrees with functionality.md and does not rely on rendered names.

Canonical reflection code guards all mutations by msid == 0, subtracts ABS(laser_pos.x - reflect_pos.x) from the retained local offset, transforms it again, updates dynamic bone 2 and sets x34. Facing reversal occurs later in physics; every reflection path returns false. Exact reflector coincidence is not established by this mixed-coordinate operation.

contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of all seven compiled-section claims: the two source table entries establish neither .data ownership nor a 48-byte extent; accessor calls establish neither .sdata string placement nor its size or padding; literal assignments establish neither .sdata2 attribution nor an ordered eight-byte pool. No compiled evidence was supplied.
Accept superseding the state-1-only physics explanation: states 0 and 1 share the callback, and the pending reflection branch explicitly performs the deferred transition.

Accept the reflection-purpose correction and defer the remaining exact-endpoint claim. Subtracting absolute world-horizontal separation from an owner-local coordinate does not generally place the resulting bone at the reflector under arbitrary owner transforms.

Accept deferral of unchanged creation-type transfer: spawning stores through greatfoxlaser.x38, explicitly identified as s16, whereas the s32 accessor reads likelike.x38. Preserve the width ambiguity rather than interpreting GetType as proof of identical values.

Accept deferral of the three Great Fox-specific capture facts and both capture links. The actual caller checks Leadead element, cooldown, capture state and a zero accessor result, not Great Fox item kind. Capture retains the generic damage source and later passes that reference to attachment and release routines. The guard and cross-file lifetime remain supported; attribution to a laser or a zero-valued Great Fox variant does not.
